recap.headline: Noel Oliveira plays in a 1–1 draw with Ashby Athletic

paragraphs.text: Fairhaven FC and Ashby Athletic drew 1–1, with Noel Oliveira in midfield.
The goal for Fairhaven FC came from Yusuf Tanaka in the 56th minute. Ashby Athletic scored through Zane Weber in the 14th minute.

Oliveira had the ball 22 times, completing 16 of 19 passes, and finished with a take-on won, a shot and an interception. In the 3rd minute Oliveira went past Hugo Delgado. In the 5th minute Oliveira headed wide. In the 46th minute Oliveira put in a cross.
Oliveira also appears in a replay.

recap.headline: Femi Toure: two goals in a 2–0 win over Calder Town

paragraphs.text: Brookfield Rovers beat Calder Town 2–0, and Femi Toure scored twice.
Toure scored in the 8th minute, set up by Leon Whitfield. Toure scored in the 13th minute.

Toure had the ball 34 times, completing 22 of 26 passes, and finished with a take-on won, five shots and an interception. In the 2nd minute Toure shot wide. In the 10th minute Toure forced a save from Noel Brennan. In the 48th minute Toure won the ball back.
Toure also appears in four replays and the highlights.

recap.headline: Femi Toure: a goal and an assist in a 2–1 win over Eastwick United

paragraphs.text: Brookfield Rovers beat Eastwick United 2–1, and Femi Toure scored once.
Toure scored in the 47th minute, set up by Milan Brennan. Toure set up Leon Whitfield's goal in the 54th minute. Eastwick United scored through Haruki Fontaine in the 52nd minute.

Toure had the ball 35 times, completing 24 of 31 passes, and finished with two shots, three interceptions and four balls won back. In the 13th minute Toure intercepted a pass. In the 15th minute Toure had a shot blocked. In the 46th minute Toure won the ball back.
Toure also appears in three replays and the highlights.

recap.headline: Leon Whitfield: a goal in a 2–1 win over Eastwick United

paragraphs.text: Brookfield Rovers beat Eastwick United 2–1, and Leon Whitfield scored once.
Whitfield scored in the 54th minute, set up by Femi Toure. The other goal for Brookfield Rovers came from Toure in the 47th minute. Eastwick United scored through Haruki Fontaine in the 52nd minute.
Whitfield had the ball 22 times, completing 13 of 14 passes, and finished with two shots. In the 12th minute Whitfield put in a cross. In the 54th minute Whitfield forced a save from Leon Oliveira.
Whitfield also appears in two replays and the highlights.

recap.headline: Haruki Fontaine: a goal in a 2–1 defeat to Brookfield Rovers

paragraphs.text: Eastwick United lost 2–1 to Brookfield Rovers, and Haruki Fontaine scored once.
Fontaine scored in the 52nd minute, set up by Hugo Ustinov. Brookfield Rovers scored through Femi Toure in the 47th minute and Leon Whitfield in the 54th minute.

Fontaine had the ball 25 times, completing 15 of 19 passes, and finished with a take-on won, a shot and a ball won back. In the 2nd minute Fontaine won the ball back. In the 5th minute Fontaine put in a cross. In the 10th minute Fontaine went past Kenan Petrov.
Fontaine also appears in two replays and the highlights.

recap.headline: Hugo Ustinov: a goal in a 1–1 draw with Ashby Athletic

paragraphs.text: Eastwick United and Ashby Athletic drew 1–1, and Hugo Ustinov scored once.
Ustinov scored in the 59th minute, set up by Ivan Santos. Ashby Athletic scored through Hugo Delgado in the 9th minute.

Ustinov had the ball 25 times, completing 16 of 21 passes, and finished with a chance created, a shot and two tackles won. In the 13th minute Ustinov won the ball from Amari Haddad. In the 46th minute Ustinov set up a chance for Haruki Fontaine. In the 53rd minute Ustinov won the ball back.

recap.headline: Amari Ustinov: an assist in a 1–1 draw with Eastwick United

paragraphs.text: Ashby Athletic and Eastwick United drew 1–1, and Amari Ustinov set up one of the goals.
Ustinov set up Hugo Delgado's goal in the 9th minute. Eastwick United scored through Hugo Ustinov in the 59th minute.

Ustinov had the ball 43 times, completing 29 of 34 passes, and finished with a chance created, a take-on won and five shots. In the 2nd minute Ustinov forced a save from Leon Oliveira. In the 5th minute Ustinov shot wide. In the 52nd minute Ustinov went past Bruno Lindqvist.
Ustinov also appears in four replays and the highlights.

recap.headline: Sami Ibarra: a goal in a 2–1 defeat to Eastwick United

recap.headline: Hugo Ustinov: a goal in a 2–1 win over Dunmore City

paragraphs.text: Eastwick United beat Dunmore City 2–1, and Hugo Ustinov scored once.
Ustinov scored in the 14th minute, set up by Gino Mensah. The other goal for Eastwick United came from Ivan Santos in the 2nd minute. Dunmore City scored through Sami Ibarra in the 51st minute.

Ustinov had the ball 38 times, completing 22 of 32 passes, and finished with a take-on won, two shots and five balls won back. In the 3rd minute Ustinov went past Pavel Petrov. In the 7th minute Ustinov forced a save from Emeka Castellanos. In the 7th minute Ustinov won the ball back.
Ustinov also appears in two replays and the highlights.

recap.headline: Yusuf Tanaka: an assist and a nutmeg in a 1–0 win over Calder Town

Tanaka set up Noel Oliveira's goal in the 3rd minute.

Tanaka had the ball 35 times, completing 26 of 31 passes, and finished with a nutmeg, two chances created and two take-ons won. In the 10th minute Tanaka nutmegged Sami Okafor. In the 12th minute Tanaka shot wide. In the 14th minute Tanaka went past Mateo Delgado.
Tanaka also appears in two replays and the highlights.

recap.headline: Femi Toure: an assist in a 1–0 win over Calder Town

paragraphs.text: Brookfield Rovers beat Calder Town 1–0, and Femi Toure set up the only goal.
Toure set up Leon Whitfield's goal in the 6th minute.

Toure had the ball 36 times, completing 23 of 30 passes, and finished with a take-on won, two shots and an interception. In the 9th minute Toure shot wide. In the 52nd minute Toure won the ball back. In the 53rd minute Toure went past Cole Rahman.
Toure also appears in a replay and the highlights.
